title: Replace your paid online store with one you build
summary: A shop owner had Claude Code build a store website, admin dashboard and Telegram order alerts, saying it replaced Shopify and saves $35 a month.
agent_role: Claude Code built the website, the admin dashboard, the checkout and the Telegram and email order alerts. The owner moved the domain and decided what features were needed.
outcome: The author reports saving $35 a month and being very happy with the result.
what_they_did: A shop owner used Claude Code to build a store website from scratch, plus an admin page that works as a dashboard. They moved their existing domain to it. Checkout uses cash on delivery, which most local customers prefer. A Telegram bot and an email alert notify them of each new order.
how_it_went: The author says it saves $35 a month compared with Shopify and covers everything they need.
worth_knowing: Skipping card payments made it much simpler. Cash on delivery was enough for their local market, which may not hold for other shops.
prompt: Help me build a simple online store to replace my [current store platform]. I sell [what you sell] and want: product pages, a checkout using [payment method, e.g. cash on delivery], an admin dashboard showing orders and stock, and a [Telegram / email] alert for every new order. First propose a plan and the tools you'll use, and wait for my approval. Build and test it locally. Don't move my domain, deploy, or connect real payments until I review and approve.

curation.rationale: A real small-business result: a custom store, admin dashboard and order alerts built with Claude Code to replace a paid platform. Light on detail and evidence.
